serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
ReliaQuest GreyMatter for Government is a cloud-native,
agentic AI-powered Security Operations Platform (SOP)
designed to detect, contain, investigate, and respond to
cybersecurity threats. By leveraging the Universal
Translator, detection-at-source, and agentic AI,
GreyMatter for Government unifies telemetry across cloud,
on-premises, and hybrid environments, delivering
centralized security and automated resilience.​
